## Description

Optimizes portfolio weights against the worst-case distribution within a Wasserstein metric ambiguity set around historical returns, ensuring stability against data perturbation.

## Where it may fit

High parameter uncertainty, severe market stress, and out-of-sample data drift environments.

## Vehicles

Institutional asset management, risk-parity funds, quantitative pension portfolios.

## Required data

Historical asset return vectors, empirical covariance matrices, Wasserstein ball radius parameters.

## Caveats

Solves computationally intensive convex reformulations; sensitive to Wasserstein radius selection.
